page.overview:
Who is Dobby Kingsman?

is the halfling innkeeper of the Sodden Grange Inn in Heartmoor Hamlet. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Dobby is very old and looks somewhat rough. He is a heavy pipe smoker, and has a very thick, bushy gray beard. Dobby's ears are large, and his gray hair is curly.

Bells Hells met Dobby when they bought rooms at the Sodden Grange Inn. Once asked by Imogen and Orym, he provided the party with plentiful information about the people and sights of Heartmoor Hamlet, including Isha Sabanis, Estani, and the Twilight Mirror Museum. Dobby specifically cautioned about coming on too strong to the townsfolk and to not take offense when residents seem distant or mistrustful; the Heartmoor Hamlet is far from large cities and has seen outsiders attempt to take advantage of this by engaging in unlawful activity. He offered a small amount of his pipe tobacco to Ashton, on request.
